osaka_jinrui_mina_menrui_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, the queue-famous shellfish-soy ramen by Minamikata] The original shop of an Osaka group, open since 2012 and in the Tabelog Ramen 100 every year from 2017 to 2025, with lines from late morning to late night (October 2026). The broth is soy sauce over clams and bonito, with a gentle sweetness that some love and some find too mild; the Macro, finished with light soy, is the clam-forward bowl, and the Genten the richer one (October 2026). Get the thick-cut chashu: slabs that fall apart, ¥1,400 with egg (October 2026). Mr. Children plays in the shop. In late 2026 the shop is being renovated and runs from a temporary site a minute away (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond access; opened 12 April 2012; Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2017–2022 and Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025 (Tabelog). Operator site unchi-co.com (Tabelog). The staff play Mr. Children live recordings (October–November 2026) and were doing the renovation in-house in October 2026; a café-bar a minute away gives half off with a same-day ramen receipt (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "This is the most popular clam-based ramen. It captures the umami of clams like asari and shijimi, finished lightly with a light soy sauce." — October 2026, Macro with sliced chashu for JPY 950.
"I didn't want to wait in line, so I visited at 3 AM." — October 2026, Ramen Genten at the temporary shop.
"The broth is said to be made with shellfish stock, but it doesn't have a strong shellfish flavor." — November 2026, Macro with thick chashu and egg.

osaka_shofuku_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, Jiro-style ramen with a heap of katsuobushi] A 12-seat counter by Minamikata, open since 2009, serving Jiro-style ramen: thick, firm noodles under a mound of bean sprouts and pork, with katsuobushi on top that adds a fishy punch you won't find at most Jiro-style shops (2026). osaka_semba_kitchen_minamisenba.notes: [Italian · Minami-Senba, a big charcoal-grill bistro] A spacious, lively Italian bistro in Minami-Senba with an open kitchen, a terrace and some 80 seats, open from 15:00. It is a place for sharing: anchovy potato salad and carpaccio, trippa, rotisserie and charcoal-grilled meats such as Tokachi beef, and fresh Awaji pasta like corn cacio e pepe, with plenty of wine. A ¥2,500 share course is good value, an October 2026 diner says. Reviews are split: many found it a pleasant surprise, while others in 2026 reported tough steak, mushy pasta, a broken chair, a seat by the restroom or brusque glass-clearing. Open late at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "Namba-Semba Food Landmark", a popular charcoal-grilled Italian in Minami-Senba with 80 seats and over 80 dishes; opened 15 September 2010. A Green House branch at Herbis Plaza is listed on Gnavi.
chef_bio.philosophy: A menu you will not tire of even if you come every day (Tabelog).

osaka_oden_soba_jinbee_namba.notes: [Oden · Namba Sennichimae, oden, wholesaler sashimi and soba] A busy oden izakaya near Nippombashi that shares the Jinbee name and the wholesaler Uoya Ebizo with Sakana no Jinbee (Tabelog), with a counter round the simmering oden pot downstairs and tatami upstairs. Order oden by the piece, homemade fish cakes, daikon, chicken wings falling off the bone, even gyoza in broth, with sashimi from that wholesaler, then finish with soba. Regulars love a dashi-wari, sake or shochu cut with the oden broth. Diners in 2026 praise the broth, the value and the happy hour; one found the broth strongly soy-flavored. Book ahead in the evening; open from noon at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: sashimi delivered daily from the partner wholesaler Uoya Ebizo, homemade nerimono oden in an Osaka-style dashi and soba to finish; a lively counter round the oden pot downstairs; rare Miyazaki shochu. An August 2026 diner writes: "This Jinbee is different from the others!"

osaka_ramuya_sennichimae.notes: [Jingisukan · Sennichimae, fresh lamb until 5 am] A small second-floor jingisukan restaurant on a back street near Nippombashi, open until 5:00 every day, serving chilled, never-frozen lamb that even first-timers find mild. Grill the chuck eye roll and leg on the jingisukan pan, let the fat drip onto the bean sprouts and chives, then add the popular lamb chops, rarer cuts like tongue, heart and liver, and finish with tsukemen in the lamb broth or the lamb curry. The staff explain cuts and cooking. Diners in 2026 call it their favorite lamb; some found the lamb chops or mutton less impressive, and smoking is allowed inside.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a fresh-lamb specialist using only the freshest lamb, with lamb chops as the most popular dish and limited lamb breast, tongue and heart; open until 5:00; opened 14 February 2017. 2026 reviews: the meat is chilled, never frozen, and staff advise searing it lightly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh, mild lamb for first-timers and those who usually avoid it (Tabelog).

Add sashimi, sea grapes and an Osaka gari chuhai. It stays open until 4:00 every night, so it fills with second and third stops. Diners in 2026 praise the broth and the takoyaki; one found the oden under-soaked and the appetizer charge high. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a clam-dashi specialist whose asari dashi is used in every dish; all the oden fish cakes are homemade; open until 4:00; opened 10 October 2013; former name 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋.

osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Lunch trays include tempura and kakiage, marinated tuna and miso soup; dinner is creative Japanese with dashi and soy seasoning.
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, tempura, dashi-based dishes.
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 17:45–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sundays and some holidays; closing times may vary (Tabelog). A June 2025 diner wrote that the shop stays open until 2:30 am; Tabelog gives 22:00. Lunch may end early once the last regulars leave (June 2025). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables for 4 and three semi-private sunken-seat rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog). About 20 sakes; menus can be tailored if booked ahead (Tabelog).
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.notes: [Japanese · Fukushima, tray lunches and sake by night] A seventeen-seat kappo near JR Fukushima, run by a father and son, the chef having trained for years at Japanese restaurants in Nishitenma (June 2025). Lunch is the local secret: a ¥1,000 or ¥1,300 tray of small dishes, marinated tuna, freshly fried kakiage eaten with salt, tamagoyaki, grilled fish and a miso soup scented with sansho, with rice refills and a dessert, at prices unchanged for years. By night it turns to creative washoku and about twenty sakes, like thick Kochi katsuo tataki or hamo fried with ginger. Cash only; lunch fills up; closed Sundays.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef's father or son (June 2025)
chef_bio.background: A June 2025 diner: "The restaurant is run by a father-son duo, with the chef having years of experience in washoku establishments in Nishitenma." Shop text (Tabelog): seasonal dishes in a warm atmosphere; authentic creative Japanese cuisine with daily specials, omakase courses and two lunch menus; menus tailored on advance booking; about 20 sakes.

"You can also opt for a large serving of rice, and the prices have remained unchanged for many years." — April 2026.

osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include soba, chawanmushi, chicken broth soup, clay-pot rice and tare skewers; write allergies in the booking request (Tabelog).
osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and duck kappo; cabbage skewers à la carte.

Courses need advance booking; write allergies or dislikes in the request; private rooms by phone; phones may go unanswered after 17:00 when busy (Tabelog). Service charge 3% (Tabelog). No minors (Tabelog). Opened October 29, 2018 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, a table for 4, private rooms for 6–8; heated tobacco only, in a designated area (Tabelog).
osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Nara chicken kappo] A twenty-seat chicken kappo on a third floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2018, built around Nara's Yamato Nikudori chicken and Yamato Gamo duck with sake from Nara. The ¥9,800 seasonal course goes well beyond skewers: chicken sashimi, a chicken-and-uni hand roll, chawanmushi rich with chicken broth, soba and clay-pot rice; a Saturday-only yakitori course is ¥6,600, and à la carte works too. Diners single out the clay-pot rice (you can take the rest home), the oyakodon and the grilled cabbage skewers. Calm counter, private rooms for business dinners; 3% service; no minors.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): chicken kaiseki featuring local Yamato Nikudori chicken and Yamato Gamo duck, with sake from Nara, "the birthplace of sake"; the master chef's skill; a calm, high-quality space. Opened October 29, 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out the appeal of Yamato chicken (Tabelog).

osaka_okihama_soba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito and kombu broth (pork bone too, per a May 2026 diner), pork toppings.
osaka_okihama_soba.hours_raw: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:00; Tue and Wed 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Sundays and holidays; irregular closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations; queue outside at lunch until called (2026 reviews). Jushi can sell out after 13:00 (May 2026). Opened September 28, 2012 (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 7 at the counter and two tables for 4–6; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_okihama_soba.notes: [Ramen · Fukushima, Okinawa soba tucked in an apartment block] A sixteen-seat Okinawa soba shop at the back of an apartment building's ground floor in Fukushima, open since 2012, that an Okinawan friend sent one diner to for the soki soba. The broth is light kombu and bonito, the noodles come from Okinawa, and the soki spare ribs and sanmai belly are braised until they melt; mozuku, aasa seaweed and Spam-and-egg bowls too, from about ¥1,000. Order jushi, the Okinawan mixed rice, before it sells out after one. Expect a short queue at lunch; dinner only Tuesday and Wednesday. Cash or PayPay; sanpin tea poured.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): an authentic Okinawa soba specialty shop in Fukushima; classic sanmai niku soba and soki soba, plus pota-tama soba and Okinawa-produced aasa soba; broth of kombu and katsuobushi with long-simmered pork, and noodles shipped directly from Okinawa. Opened September 28, 2012.

"The Jushi was even better than what I had previously eaten in Okinawa." — May 2026.
"The noodles had a light flavor with a gentle aroma of dashi (broth)." — September 2026.

osaka_koya_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of foie gras, caviar, seafood and Omi beef.
osaka_koya_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Short courses from 20:30 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026). Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2023 and 2025.
osaka_koya_kitashinchi.notes: [French · Kitashinchi, an eight-seat wine-bar counter] An eight-seat L-shaped counter on a third floor in Kitashinchi, running since 2002 and on Tabelog's French WEST 100, that calls itself a wine bar but serves an omakase of creative French dishes with Japanese touches: corned beef from Okazaki Farm, caviar-topped rice, foie gras in unexpected pairings, and sirloin from cattle fed for 49 months. About ten dishes cost ¥19,800, a later short course ¥15,400, and the drinks are wine and beer only, with regulars opening grand Bordeaux. Diners love the owner's easy explanations and the relaxed counter; one found the food over-intricate and the room hot in May.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a hidden gem for adults near Kitashinchi Station; creative French courses that highlight natural flavours with simple yet refined dishes; the chef's special course of long-fed Omi beef; an extensive wine list; a relaxed, homey atmosphere with a comfortable distance from the owner. Opened March 3, 2002. The official site calls it a wine bar in Kitashinchi.

osaka_men_dokoro_horibata_mikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles from Saitama; shoyu and shio-koji seasoning.
osaka_men_dokoro_horibata_mikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-bone or niboshi broth; beef and pork chashu.
osaka_men_dokoro_horibata_mikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). The shop blog posts extra closures and holidays. No reservations; no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); tickets from a cash machine (2024–2025). 8 counter seats (Tabelog); a 2025 diner also saw two tables. Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). Reopened as a ramen shop on 7 March 2024 (reviews; shop blog); the Tabelog opening date, 26 May 2016, is from the izakaya before it.
osaka_men_dokoro_horibata_mikuni.notes: [Ramen · Hankyu Mikuni, one man’s beef-bone shio near the station] An 8-seat counter two minutes from Hankyu Mikuni, where the owner, after some 25 years running the Horibata izakaya, turned the Mikuni shop into a ramen bar in March 2024 and now works it alone. The signature is a rare thing in Osaka, a beef-bone shio: a clear, gentle golden broth with homemade shio-koji, slices of rare beef chashu and Saitama noodles, thin or thick (¥890, 2025). The charred-niboshi shoyu, finished with sizzling oil, is the bolder bowl; autumn 2026 brings a rich chicken-paitan shoyu. Cash tickets; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop blog (nonbei-horibata.heart-g.net, read 2026-11-02): 魚菜処 ほりばた ran three izakaya, in 此花, 豊中 and 三国, for about 25 years; during the COVID-19 years the owner turned to take-home recipes and frozen food by mail, and to the ramen long wanted; "as a cook" the owner used what was learned running izakaya to change what the shop serves, reopening as 麺処 ほりばた in March 2024. Per reviews: the owner "previously ran a Japanese restaurant", buys ingredients directly from Okayama and makes the shio-koji and soy sauce (March 2025); a school friend says the owner, who had no ramen training, "had been making various broths since [the] days in the seafood business" (August 2025); "The owner runs the place alone" (October 2024); "The owner was also incredibly friendly" (November 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A beloved local establishment" built on years as a cook (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef-bone shio ramen; charred-niboshi shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is clear and, as it looks, very gentle and smooth. You can feel a slight saltiness in the aftertaste." — May 2024, beef-bone shio ¥850.
"My companion ordered the grilled niboshi, which came topped with piping hot umami oil drizzled from a skillet." — September 2024.
"This restaurant offers a rare opportunity to enjoy beef bone ramen in Osaka, a specialty that’s popular in parts of Tottori and Yamaguchi." — July 2024.

osaka_tezukuri_gyoza_hashizato_kan_kikaw.notes: [Gyoza · Juso and Minamikata, a couple’s handmade gyoza in every style] A 19-seat gyoza shop on Yodogawa-dori between Juso and Nishinakajima-Minamigata, opened in 2022 and run by a couple. Every gyoza is made by hand with a chewy skin, and you choose both the filling, from pork and shiitake to myoga or mapo tofu, and whether it comes fried, steamed or boiled. Lunch sets of gyoza or Liu Mama’s mapo tofu are ¥780 with rice and soup (2025); in the evening a ¥1,000 quick-drink set and all-you-can-drink with fruit sours or Shaoxing wine. Open 11:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays; cards and PayPay.

osaka_asabiki_buta_butta_mikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork skewers and offal, horse sashimi, pork ramen.

osaka_asabiki_buta_butta_mikuni.notes: [Izakaya · Hankyu Mikuni, morning-butchered pork skewers behind a plastic curtain] An 18-seat yakiton bar a minute from Hankyu Mikuni, at the mouth of the shopping street, its counter sealed off by a plastic curtain like a street stall. The pork is butchered that morning, and the skewers run from the familiar to lips, throat and rectum, most at ¥170–250 (2026); regulars swear by the barely-cooked liver with salt, and a spicy miso ramen closes the night. Hoppy, rare in Osaka, is on tap, the TV shows baseball and the walls hold wrestlers’ autographs. Open 18:00 to midnight; closed Tuesdays; cash only; smoking allowed, so adults only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a morning-butchered pork specialist with offal, pork dishes and ramen; adults only because smoking is allowed. A sister shop, 朝挽豚専門店 ぶった 西中島店, appears in the sweep list. Per reviews: "They offer a wide selection of horumon, including almost everything from the pig’s mouth to its rear end" (March 2014); the ramen banner first went up during the 2021 state of emergency (August–December 2021); "greeted by the owner as I took my seat at the counter" (September 2024); wrestlers’ autographs and Hanshin Tigers support on show (2024–2025); "The owner was very kind" (May 2026, a regular on the eighth visit).

anecdotes.text: "Even though it’s skewered, it was like raw liver! And it’s pork!" — May 2026, liver ¥150.

osaka_karai_monya_guillotine_shinmachi.notes: [Spicy izakaya · Shinmachi, choose your heat from 0 to 10] An open-fronted street-side izakaya near Yotsubashi where fried rice, mapo tofu and sundubu come at heat levels from mild to "God" (10), with the "curse" fried rice as the challenge dish. chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opened 1 May 2009; website gilotine.com. Other shops, 船場本店 and 大正店, are listed on HotPepper (search result); the brand also sells its spice blends online.

osaka_yakiniku_kurono_ura_namba.notes: [Yakiniku · Ura Namba, whole-cattle Oita wagyu] A large, clean yakiniku in Ura Namba, opened in September 2024, built on Oita wagyu bought as whole cattle through direct ties with Oita farms, so courses run from tongue and yukhoe to rare cuts at modest prices. A tail soup said to come from the owner's mother finishes the meal. Diners in 2026 praise the light fat, the green-onion sauce and the value, and families come on weekday evenings; one September diner found the meat sinewy and the service slow. Groups use the second floor.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog menu, the house wanted to share Oita wagyu at a great value and visited the Oita Livestock Public Corporation, farms and fattening ranches to set up direct partnerships; its tail soup of beef bones is "passed down from my mother". Tabelog says celebrities come incognito. Opened 29 September 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The perfect everyday beef you can enjoy any time" (Tabelog menu).

anecdotes.text: "They offer both Kyushu-style and regular sauces, but the Oita beef is so exquisite that just salt and wasabi are enough." — September 2026.
"The meat had a lot of sinew and was difficult to chew." — September 2026.
"Even on a weekday evening, it was quite lively with families dining in." — October 2026.

Seasonal fish and vegetables are grilled over charcoal behind the counter, alongside tempura and Kyoto-style oden, with about fifty sakes including rare labels and all-you-can-drink sake courses even for one. Lunch gozen sets are a quiet holiday option. Diners in 2026 enjoy the sake range and the food; one found service slow and courses thin, another that a favourite dish had shrunk.

osaka_ura_namba_sushi_to_fuji.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi is served with soy sauce, and the menu also has tempura, fried smelt and oden (Tabelog menu; reviews).
osaka_ura_namba_sushi_to_fuji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and oden izakaya; no vegan options are described.

osaka_ura_namba_sushi_to_fuji.notes: [Sushi · Ura Namba, red-vinegar sushi at izakaya prices] A clean, spacious second-floor sushi izakaya on Sennichimae's central street, opened in April 2024, pairing red-vinegar sushi rice with house oden at modest prices. Diners in 2026 like the tuna, the grilled fish and the quick staff, and several note many visitors from abroad arriving with guidebooks; one found the tuna pricey, another bits of shell in the raw oysters. It is easy to miss from the street.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, fish comes direct from across Japan, the rice blends Edomae red vinegar with Kansai rice vinegar and is served at a warm temperature, and the soy sauce is chosen to bring out the fish; the head chef changes the five-piece set's toppings each time. Opened 11 April 2024.

anecdotes.text: "It's popular among inbound tourists, who often come in with guidebooks in hand." — October 2026, third visit.
"Of course, the sushi was great, but the grilled fish was surprisingly delicious for such a low price." — August 2026.
"The sushi was fresh and quite tasty, but when we ordered the raw oysters, there were some shell fragments left, which affected the texture negatively." — August 2026.

osaka_tanuki_chaya_sennichimae.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Robata-grilled seafood, vegetables and skewers come with salt, soy sauce or butter; fried dishes are on the menu too (Tabelog menu).
osaka_tanuki_chaya_sennichimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled vegetables exist (yam, eggplant, shiitake, corn) but butter and shared grills are used; no vegan options are described.
osaka_tanuki_chaya_sennichimae.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (last food order 22:30, drinks 22:45); closed 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Reservations taken, same day online too (September 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; Osaka City Premium Vouchers accepted (Tabelog). 138 seats with counter and private rooms for 6–8; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_tanuki_chaya_sennichimae.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, ¥385 robatayaki] A big, Japanese-style robatayaki of the 力丸 group beside Namba Walk exit 25, open from 4 PM, where nearly every grilled item costs ¥385. Enter through a round door to a counter facing the grill and the displayed seafood; the butter-grilled live scallop is the signature. Diners in 2026 love the value, the fresh shellfish and the show at the counter, and note the room fills with tourists; one found the meat in a course overcooked and the sashimi weak. Children enjoy the counter.

roles: Grill staff unnamed; a shop of the 力丸 group (brand page)
chef_bio.background: Per the 力丸 group's brand page, たぬき茶屋 has one shop, in Namba; Tabelog gives the opening as 25 April 2012. An August 2026 diner remembers visiting the site before it was called Tanuki Chaya; an October 2026 diner came after a good visit to a sister shop in Umeda.

anecdotes.text: "The atmosphere is inviting as you enter through the round door, leading to the counter seats where you can see the robatayaki being prepared right in front of you." — August 2026.
"The place was almost full, packed with tourists!!!" — July 2026, second visit.
"We had kids with us, and it seemed that only the counter seats were available, but the children were thrilled, so it worked out well." — September 2026.

osaka_cheongang_korean_mikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: Korean stews and grills with chili pastes and sauces, plus ramen sundubu, jeon pancakes and noodles. Ask about single dishes.
osaka_cheongang_korean_mikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, offal, chicken and seafood stews, with raw egg added to sundubu.

Reservations accepted; dinner is often fully booked, so book (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (incl. PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog). Order by QR code (June 2026). 17 seats: 5 at the counter, two tables for two and two for four (Tabelog; July 2026); smoking area for heated tobacco only; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 13 October 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_cheongang_korean_mikuni.notes: [Korean · Mikuni, sundubu lunches and samgyeopsal nights by the shopping street] A small, busy Korean restaurant opened in 2024 just off the Mikuni shopping street, full even before noon (June 2026). At lunch, pick a bubbling sundubu (pork kimchi, offal, chicken or seafood) at a spice level from 1 to 5, stir in the raw egg, and get three banchan and rice (2025–2026). At night it is samgyeopsal brought to the table already grilled, spicy octopus, dakhanmari, bossam and a "bomb" steamed egg, with makgeolli (2026). Lunch about ¥1,000–1,500; book for dinner. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 13 October 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers: a cute Korean-style room that is busy at lunch (2025–2026); friendly staff who let one diner in two minutes before opening (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The Bomb Gyeran-jjim (steamed egg), which had a striking appearance and a fluffy texture with a gentle taste, exceeding my expectations in deliciousness." — April 2026, dinner.
"I ordered the pork kimchi jjigae for lunch, and I could choose the spiciness level from 1 to 5, so of course, I went for 5." — July 2026.
"They brought it grilled, so we could eat it right away, which was great." — July 2026, samgyeopsal at lunch.

osaka_star_ramen_higashimikuni.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Mikuni, a one-woman morning-ramen counter with star-shaped eggs] A tiny morning-ramen counter north of Higashi-Mikuni Station, open only Friday to Sunday from 7:00 to 14:00, where the owner cooks and serves alone, quickly, under Toy Story figurines (October 2026). The bowl is the "Akira Star": thin straight noodles in a light, peppery soy broth heaped with bean sprouts and Kujo green onions, ¥900; add the star-shaped "Egg Star" for ¥200 (October 2026). Watch the social media for limited bowls such as a rich niboshi ramen (October 2026). House rules are strict: photos of your food only, no firm-noodle requests. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 8 May 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "The owner is a woman" (October 2026); "The owner runs the place alone, and even though we were a group of four, the service was quick and efficient" (October 2026); limited bowls are announced on the shop's social media (October 2026). The menu nods to "Akira-style" ramen, per a regular (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The light soy sauce broth and simple ramen are so delicious that I never get tired of it, even after having it two weeks in a row." — October 2026, Akira Star for JPY 900.
"The star-shaped egg was perfectly soft-boiled and also delicious!" — October 2026, chashu ramen with Star Egg.
"This is a special menu item not available on the vending machine, so be sure to try it when you see it announced on Star Ramen's SNS!" — October 2026, limited niboshi ramen for about JPY 1,300.

osaka_el_nague_nonakakita.notes: [Spanish · Nonakakita, paella in a 90-year-old former post office] A retro Spanish restaurant open since 2010 in a 90-year-old former post office on Route 176, with mimosa in the garden and a warm, old-house dining room (Tabelog; January 2025). One cook runs it, yet the food comes steadily: a mixed appetiser plate, gambas al ajillo with bread, grilled Iberico pork, squid-ink paella and the seafood paella the shop is proudest of (Tabelog; February 2026). Lunch is just three paella sets, from about ¥1,300 (2025–2026). Dinner for two with drinks runs about ¥8,000 (2026). A walk from any station, so locals book it out; reserve. Jazz and other live events may be held on Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: retro Spanish cooking with fresh seafood from the fishing port, in a former post office built 90 years ago, mixing Japanese and Western styles; occasional live events including jazz; opened 28 July 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "The master runs the place alone" (February 2026); detailed explanations of the menu (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The master runs the place alone, but the speed of drink and food service is perfectly fine (orders are placed via mobile phone)." — February 2026, dinner for two at JPY 7,880.
"I highly recommend the Sawara (Spanish mackerel) a la Bilbaina." — July 2026.
"The paella was rich with the flavor of seafood broth and included a large shrimp!" — January 2025, paella lunch for JPY 1,400.

The deluxe bowl with extra egg, chashu and nori is ¥1,150; negi ramen ¥1,000 (2026). A reviewer from Kanagawa found it true to iekei with a Kansai lean toward green onions (June 2026). Cash only; ticket machine.

No service or room charge. Saturday lunch by reservation the day before.

osaka_hinabe_penguin.notes: [Chinese · Kitashinchi, a personal medicinal hot pot] A fourteen-seat hot-pot room near Kitashinchi Station, opened in April 2026, done up in Showa-retro style, where each diner gets an individual pot. The broth, from chicken, naratake mushroom and lily buds with herbs weighed to a tenth of a gram, was devised by the hot-pot-obsessed cook 東山広樹 after trips through Guizhou and Yunnan, and comes spicy or mild. The single ¥8,800 course brings TOKYO X pork, Kyoto red chicken and wagyu from a hard-to-book Sakai yakiniku shop, then ramen in the broth and a light dessert. Diners leave warm, and one felt good the next day. Two-hour seating; ¥880 charge.

osaka_yuki_no_michi_fukushima.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Fukushima, a retro teppan for lunch sets] A fifteen-seat old-style okonomiyaki and teppan shop in the same Fukushima apartment block as Okihama Soba and Gotoku, open weekdays only. osaka_kitashinchi_kokono.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, game meat and sake till 1 am] A thirty-seat basement izakaya in Kitashinchi, open since 2019 and designed by its owner, a former interior designer, for people tired of ordinary menus: a game hot pot of boar, venison, ostrich, kangaroo, crocodile and seasonal badger, with Hokkaido brown bear, kangaroo yukhoe and smoked crocodile tail à la carte. osaka_sakedokoro_kitazo_dotonbori.notes: [Izakaya · Dotonbori, sushi and sake over the river] A second-floor sushi and seafood izakaya just off the Dotonbori arcade, 20 years in Osaka, with window seats and private rooms looking over the Dotonbori River. Come for thick-cut bluefin tuna and rare cuts, fish-liver sashimi, original fish skewers and sushi, with the owner's changing list of sake. Diners in 2026 call it a reliable, not-touristy find with fair prices; one group found the grilled items slow. Note the booking rule: groups with overseas tourists must phone first or face a ¥1,500 per person fee. Open to 1:00, closed Mondays.

osaka_jiyaki_unagi_hozenji_yamakazu.notes: [Unagi · Hozenji Yokocho, charcoal-grilled Kansai eel] A three-storey wooden townhouse in Hozenji Yokocho grilling eel the Kansai way, straight over binchotan without steaming, so the skin is crisp and the flesh juicy, under a lighter sauce than most. Order the unaju or the hitsumabushi, with umaki and grilled liver to start; the unagi don comes with soup and chawanmushi. Upstairs are quiet tatami rooms, shoes off, away from the smoke of the ground-floor grill. Diners in 2026 praise the crisp eel and the setting; a few found the portions small, the sansho weak or the service patchy. Lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Kansai-style grilled-eel house in a traditional three-storey building in Hozenji Yokocho, grilling large seasonal eels over binchotan without steaming; fresh fish and drinking snacks; sake chosen to go with eel; opened 1 December 2022.

osaka_cucina_tei_awaza.notes: [Ramen · Awaza, porcini chicken-paitan ramen by day, private hot pots by night] A second-floor ramen shop near the Awaza crossing, filled with Maximum the Hormone posters and band signatures, that serves a frothy chicken paitan at lunch built on porcini, vegetables and olive oil, with thin curly noodles, pink chashu and chicken ham; add the basil green sauce for an Italian turn. The broth is built on miso from Hokkaido’s Iwata brewery with curly egg noodles from Hokkaido, rich and a little sweet; corn butter (¥1,100) is the regulars’ favourite, and the spicy-and-numbing miso, with heat to order, is only made here (2026). Fried rice and gyoza sets on the side. Open daily to 1:30; no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "The Pioneer of Miso Ramen"; Iwata Brewing miso from Hokkaido; noodles airlifted from Hokkaido; a house blend of white, black and gold sesame roasted in the shop; the spiced miso ramen only at the Mikuni shop. Part of a small group: 味噌之達人 箕面本店 in 箕面市今宮 (Gurunavi; Ramen DB), and a 2015 blog names a 川西池田 shop as the parent of this one. Per reviews: "the chef and a female staff member were running the place together" (September 2026); an apron lent on request (September 2026); "It may seem like a chain restaurant in Osaka, but it truly captures the flavors of Sapporo" (August 2026); one diner found the floor sticky (May 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Miso ramen with freshly ground sesame; spicy-and-numbing miso.

anecdotes.text: "While waiting for my order, I diligently ground sesame seeds with a pestle and added them to the bowl once it was served. The aroma of sesame filled the air." — September 2026, corn butter ramen ¥1,100.
"For the Spicy and Numbing Miso Ramen, I could choose the levels of spiciness and numbing sensation, so I went with level 3 for both." — March 2026, ¥1,000.
"Unquestionably the taste of Sapporo!" — August 2026.

osaka_cheese_dining_itaru_mikuni.notes: [Cheese · Hankyu Mikuni, raclette and fondue from a prize-winning cheese chef] A 23-seat cheese restaurant three minutes from Hankyu Mikuni, marked by a cow statue at the door, whose owner-chef was runner-up in a 2023 cheese-art fromager competition. The chef often runs the room alone but service keeps pace (2026). Book ahead at lunch; closed Mondays; cards accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: cheeses from around the world and selected wines; dishes by a chef who was runner-up in the Cheese Art Fromager Competition 2023. Per the shop site (cd-itaru.jp, read 2026-11-02): a cheese specialist where guests experience "the unknown world of cheese" through cooking; classic cheese dishes at lunch, a wider range of cheeses at dinner; three cheese sweets sold online. Per reviews: "The restaurant was run by a quiet owner-chef who managed everything on [the chef’s] own" (January 2026); "the staff seemed busy serving solo" (August 2026); a cheese-making video plays on screens inside (October 2026); "the owner chef might seem quiet at first, but [was] very pleasant" and has been on TV (June 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Cheese is actually very deep": the animal, the land and the history behind each one, shown through cooking (site, translated).

osaka_yoshoku_bistro_ippou_bijin_dojima.notes: [Yoshoku · Dojima, a hidden wine bistro] A sixteen-seat bistro up a staircase on a club-lined Dojima street, open since 2024 and late every night, run by a chef and one other staff member in July 2026. The free-flow of about ten wines is popular, and diners call it good value for Kitashinchi. ¥600 starter charge à la carte; heated tobacco allowed.

Reservations taken; same-day cancellations charged (courses in full, seats ¥4,000 a head); party-size changes after 23:00 the day before charged (Tabelog). A service fee is added (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted. Orders by QR code (August 2026 review).
osaka_kotteji_sennichimae.notes: [Korean · Namba Sennichimae, all-you-can-eat samgyeopsal] A big K-pop-filled Korean restaurant on Sennichimae-dori, a minute from Namba Station, that calls itself the first in Japan to offer all-you-can-eat samgyeopsal and says many Korean artists visit. Staff grill the thick Hanazaki pork belly with grilled kimchi at the table, and side dishes in the buffet are cooked to order in small portions. Diners in 2026 like the juicy pork, the chijimi and the fried chicken, and note many young customers; one found the QR ordering confusing, another the buffet more than a light eater needs.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, Kotteji is the first restaurant in Japan to introduce all-you-can-eat samgyeopsal, offered "in response to the desire for more freedom in dining"; the room plays K-pop and is said to be visited by many Korean artists.
chef_bio.specialty: Hanazaki (flowering) samgyeopsal on a stone grill.

anecdotes.text: "The staff grilled the samgyeopsal for us, so we could enjoy it without worrying about the cooking time." — October 2026.
"Even though it's all-you-can-eat, each dish is made to order, ensuring everything is served hot and fresh." — September 2026.
"Ordering via the QR code was a bit confusing, and I accidentally ordered extra meat" — August 2026, premium course.

osaka_nikusawa_namba_honten.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Horumon comes in rich, salt, red and curry seasonings; the menu has yukgaejang ramen and potato salad (Tabelog menu; reviews).
osaka_nikusawa_namba_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and offal yakiniku; kimchi is a side and is not described.
osaka_nikusawa_namba_honten.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–24:00 (last food order 23:00); closed 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations taken; 2-hour limit at peak times (Tabelog). ¥330 appetizer charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money. 87 seats; private hire for up to 50 (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (July 2026 review).
osaka_nikusawa_namba_honten.notes: [Yakiniku · Sennichimae, a wholesaler's casual yakiniku] A big, casual yakiniku three minutes from Nippombashi Station, opened in June 2023 and run directly by a meat wholesaler, open from noon to midnight. Horumon comes in four house seasonings and the A5 wagyu is cheap for its grade; bottled beer is ¥299. Diners in 2026 single out the thick fresh liver, the four-horumon platter and the salted tongue; one August group found the course small and the staff inflexible. Good for groups and daytime drinking.

roles: Staff unnamed; directly run by a meat wholesaler (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, Nikusawa is "a fusion of meat wholesale and casual yakiniku", directly operated by a meat wholesale company so it can serve A5 wagyu cheaply, with horumon prepared and seasoned to suit each cut. Opened 14 June 2023.

anecdotes.text: "The most impressive dish was the thick, fresh liver✨. It was fresh, free of any unpleasant odor, and incredibly delicious." — July 2026.
"What surprised me this time was that bottled beer was around JPY 290!!" — August 2026.
"The drink service was decent, but we ordered a course and found the portions to be small and unsatisfactory." — August 2026, group of four.

osaka_kogi_seoul_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pork belly is grilled plain, but chukumi, nakgopsae and bulgogi are sauced, and the menu has chijimi, japchae, tteokbokki, kimbap and kalguksu (Tabelog menu; reviews).
osaka_kogi_seoul_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a samgyeopsal and Korean restaurant; no vegan options are described.
osaka_kogi_seoul_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30); lunch at weekends and holidays only (Tabelog). Reservations taken; a ¥330 weekend fee on courses (Fri–Sun, holidays and the eve of holidays) and a December surcharge (Tabelog). Children under elementary-school age are not admitted, for safety (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay. The entrance is hard to find, in a dim alley off the arcade with a small sign (October 2026 review).
osaka_kogi_seoul_namba.notes: [Korean · Namba, samgyeopsal in a hidden second-floor room] A stylish samgyeopsal restaurant on the second floor of a building off the Ebisubashi arcade, a minute from Namba Station exit 11, opened July 2024; the entrance is easy to miss down a dim alley. Staff cook the aged thick pork belly and the chukumi samgyeopsal at the table, with chijimi, japchae and cheese dishes on the side. Diners in 2026 like the food and the Korea-trip atmosphere, and note many young women; one September diner who knows the Tennoji shop found service here slow. Pre-school children are not admitted.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the top recommendation is the aged thick-cut pork samgyeopsal, served with courses that include three Korean dishes; the interior is meant to feel like a trip to Korea. Opened 26 July 2024. Hot Pepper lists a コギソウル 京都河原町店, and a September 2026 diner compares it with a Tennoji shop.

anecdotes.text: "The atmosphere and service here are definitely better at the Tennoji location!" — September 2026.
"It's great that the staff prepares the dishes, allowing you to enjoy your meal at a leisurely pace." — September 2026.
"It's located in a dim alley just off the arcade, and the sign is quite small." — October 2026.
